dog.description_text:
Meet Keaton, a sweet, sensitive soul!

Keaton is searching for a quiet home to call his own. Looking for a buddy to sit with you while you read on the couch? Or maybe someone to split a delicious can of tuna with? Keaton’s your guy!

Keaton may have the fullest cheeks we have ever seen. But there is more to him to admire than that. We suspect his cheeks are chock full of love! Where else could he be stashing that adoring personality? Now he just needs someone to share his life with.

If you’d like to learn more about adopting Keaton, click the “Adopt Me” button!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
